Test-only package from `training/configs/smoke.yaml`: tiny models, useless for real detection, used to check that
the C# runtime matches the Python reference (`golden.json`). `melspectrogram.onnx` and `embedding_model.onnx` are
from [openWakeWord](https://github.com/dscripka/openWakeWord) v0.5.1, Apache-2.0.
